import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototypes
# gsl_rng_env_setup has no arguments and returns void
# gsl_rng_alloc takes a pointer to gsl_rng_type and returns a pointer to gsl_rng
# gsl_rng_name takes a pointer to gsl_rng and returns a const char*
# gsl_rng_get takes a pointer to gsl_rng and returns an unsigned long
# gsl_rng_free takes a pointer to gsl_rng and returns void

# Setup the environment
setup = gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup
setup()

# Get the default RNG type
gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default')

# Allocate the RNG
alloc = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc
alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
rng = alloc(gsl_rng_default)

# Get the RNG name
name = gsl.gsl_rng_name
name.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
rng_name = name(rng).decode('utf-8')

# Get the default seed
default_seed = ctypes.c_ulong.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default_seed')

# Get the first random value
get = gsl.gsl_rng_get
get.restype = ctypes.c_ulong
first_value = get(rng)

# Free the RNG
free = gsl.gsl_rng_free
free(rng)

# Print the results
print(f'generator type: {rng_name}')
print(f'seed = {default_seed.value}')
print(f'first value = {first_value}')

# Assertion tests

def assert_test():
    assert isinstance(rng_name, str), "RNG name should be a string"
    assert isinstance(default_seed.value, int), "Seed should be an integer"
    assert isinstance(first_value, int), "First value should be an integer"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
